note: Middle-aged man who hired your party in Ashwood. He hired you to steal Alric's Locket
title: Orman Harrington

note: My brother passed several years ago. He was a crafter. He made jewelry. This is all I have left of his. This was stolen by an influential elf. A powerful mage I suspect. I would ask the guards for assistance but they do not help when it involves mages or the connected, also they would ask for proof it is mine and I have none. This mage, his name is Alric. I would not ask you to try to take it from him directly, I know that is beyond your abilities. No, I was unable to seek this item out until recently. It has come to my attention that he has gifted the item away, to someone of far less means. Someone I think that is within your abilities. Her name Gilda. I suspect his wife would not like to know about her.
title: Orman Harrington Request

note: Alric is slender, with sharp elven features. He dresses in elegant green and gold finery, embroidered with thorn motifs and adorned with tiny bells that chime softly with his movements. Soft leather boots rise to mid-calf, supple and well-made. A silver chain rests just beneath his collar, mostly hidden. He carries a slim cane—clearly decorative, but possibly more—and a silver ring set with a black opal gleams whenever it catches the light. He never seems to give a straight answer; often speaks in rhymes or riddles. Seems constantly amused.
title: Alric Thorne

note: Alric's wife. Elven woman with silver eyes. Was last seen wearing a dark crimson cloak over black leather and a silver necklace of a wasp. Worshiper of Callistria
title: Virelle

note: Alric and Virelle's friend. Virelle didn't seem to like her much. Sylwen is a striking elf with angular features and long silver hair that flows like a silken veil. Her lavender eyes glow faintly in low light, and her skin carries an ethereal, almost translucent quality. She is of average elven height, graceful and slender, last seen wearing a deep violet robe adorned with silver embroidery. Her movements are fluid, and she seems to always be poised.
title: Sylwen

note: Stumpy pretended to lose his balance tripping into a waitress and pulled her blouse down and Olga spat her drink out over a flame in suprise to the sudden sight. Meanwhile, using the distraction, Lysander tried to lift the necklace. Lysander failed and ended up ripping it off her neck attracting the attention of the guards and a priestess. Lysander ran but not before getting a firebolt to his ass.
title: The Theft

note: Looking at the locket after escaping Lysander saw a middle aged elven looking man inside
title: The Locket

note: Collecting their reward the party neglected to tell Orman about their partial failure. They were supposed to do it unnoticed
title: Reward

note: The party fled town and made it to a village several days away. They awoke the next day to three people in their room: Alric, Virelle, and Sylwen. Virelle demanded they be executed but Alric thought that was too dull and uninteresting of a punishment. He instead sent them to his sisters as he put it. Before being banished to the fey wilds Stumpy was given a bottle of ale that Alric never asked to be returned.
title: Caught

note: You suddenly find yourselves standing inside a vast chamber, the air thick with the scent of blooming flowers and the rich earthiness of moss. The walls are not walls at all but living, breathing plants—intertwining vines and creeping ivy wrap around the stone, their leaves pulsing faintly with light. Thick flowers of every color imaginable hang from the ceiling like chandeliers, their petals opening and closing in rhythm with some unseen, gentle breeze.
title: Arrival in the Fey Wilds

note: Dala Nyssira is a fey noble who agreed to send the party back home in exchange for a few tasks. She is a tall, ethereal figure with pale, green-tinged skin and piercing golden amber eyes that occasionally shimmer with light. Her long, silvery hair flows in soft waves, interwoven with flowers and ivy that slowly moves and shifts on it’s own. She wears a gown made of living flowers, each blooming with insects flying around drinking the nectar. Her movements are graceful and silent, and her voice is musical, carrying both an enchanting and commanding presence.
title: Dala Nyssira

note: Intruders into my realm. How brave must you be to come here? I could simply send you back to the mundane, but what would be the fun in that? No, no. I have tasks that need to be done. I am bored and uninterested in such trivial things my playthings. You could do them though, I think five tasks wouldn’t take you too long, but then again time can get very stretchy out here. How many years has already passed I wonder
title: Dala's Request

note: Frendamus is late in delivering Dala's slippers. The slippers were stolen and after some investigation a trail was followed to a warehouse owned by a Lark named Lydia. They find Lydia dancing uncontrolably in the corner. Finding the slippers they left her to her fate but not before helping themselves to some of her possessions.
title: First Task

note: Frendamus is greatly relieved you found the slippers and rewarded you with your choice of footware. She seems confused about any questions related to the purpose or abilities of her items. Olga notes some footwraps that she decides to keep. Crude at first glance—just heavy bands of leather and knotted cord—but each strap bears burn-scars, bite-marks, and dried blood. When bound tightly up the calves and feet, they flex and pulse with primal tension. The name Martha is burned into the inside of one of the straps.
title: Reward

note: Olga's nose appears to grow a bit larger and Stumpy turns greenish. It is suspected that the fey food had this effect on them. Olga's sense of smell improves and Stumpy seems to need less food. These changes eventually go away after returning home
title: Strange Effects

note: Now. My feast draws near, and I grow bored of honeyed fruits and marrowless bones. I crave something wild. Bring me an emberboar. Alive. Chained, if you must, but breathing. I want its rage hot and thrashing when I slit its throat beneath the bloom moon.
title: Second Task

note: The party located the Wild Hunt after a few weeks of waiting and gathering information. Deciding it would be reckless to show up without something to show they decide to hunt a bear. One is found and a trophy is made of it.
title: Wild Hunt Preperations

note: The path winds through twisted groves and bioluminescent thickets until the trees suddenly part, revealing a wide, slow-moving river gleaming beneath the wan light of a shifting Feywild moon. Mist surrounds the area, curling and dancing like living things. The scent of moss and wildflowers is thick in the air, mingled with the faint, metallic tang of old blood. Upon approaching they are given a riddle but are unable to solve it. Next it is requested the share a deed of valor which Stumpy does. Instead of challenging them to a duel, as is custom, the offering of the bear trophy sufficed.
title: Wild Hunt

note: Eladrin Undead Skeleton Mage. A gaunt, skeletal figure clad in bark-wrapped chainmail, with a tattered cloak of autumn leaves and a massive stag skull fused to her own. Her breath fogs unnaturally warm even in the chill air.
title: Harkon of the Hollow Antler, Master of the Tally

note: Elven noble so enraged with his former lover that he convinced the Wild Hunt to kill her.
title: Athach

note: Lysander recognized Athach from the locket and decided to investigate him as subtly as he could. Athach was uninterested in talking to anyone wanting only to sulk. Stumpy challenged him to a drinking contest and won the mans most valuable possession: A name written on a piece of paper. Athach laughed as they took it mentioning how the name would get them killed. Lysander then robbed him finding several gems worth nearly a thousand gold, the most by far that Lysander had ever stolen. He also found a key with the name Orin engraved in it.
title: Robbing a drunk

note: Lysander made friends with Harkon and secured a promise of a future meeting.
title: Interesting Friends

note: The boar was killed and delivered to Dala
title: Successfull Hunt

note: True elf guest at the feast, distant relative of Princess Dala. Foppish, rich, arrogant, and deeply insecure
title: Severus

note: Getting the boar in time for the feast Dala tasks the party to attend so that she may show you off to her guests. The party manages to acquire a false bottomed chalice, steal a ring from a rude noble, and fingerbang a drunk chick.
title: Third Task

note: The party is asked to help a hopeless Satyr find love.
title: Fourth Task

title: Petey

note: The players find themselves back in Ashwood in the Stumbling Stag. 43 have passed
title: Return to Ashwood

note: A wiry woman in her 60s with a perpetually worried expression and a sharp tongue. She's practical, skeptical of adventurers, but too desperate to turn down help.
title: Mayor Tamsin Holt

note: “Gerrick Bain hasn’t come into town in three days, and now his neighbors say his farm’s gone silent. Chickens, cows—everything’s gone. I’ll give you twenty gold to take a look and come back with something useful.”
title: Mayor Tamsin Holt

note: Gerrick's house was empty, but no sign of a fight. It appeared all of his animals were led away
title: Investigation

note: Following the tracks they found two cultists complaining about wanting to kill 'that bitch'. The party quickly killed one and subdued the other only to find out they were complaining about carrying water for a cow who was the 'bitch' they were complaining about. Lysander decided they needed to kill them to avoid reprisals even though it appeared they were innocent.
title: Cultist

note: Following the tracks further they found a cave and took out the two guards, then disguised their voices and appearance (using magic) as the cultists. They tried to lure people to come out and be ambushed but the lead cultist was busy completing his ritual. He got annoyed with stumpy and used a spell to crush stumpies heart, then enthralled everyone forcing them to watch as he completed his ritual. Olga, enhanced by her legwraps, overcame the compulsion and killed him. Watching him twitching on the ground Olga felt compelled to finish him and watched as the axe drank up his essence. The other cultists were slaughtered.
title: Sha’tin Cult Cave

note: Alric's locket, taken from the party before being sent to the fey wilds was found on one of the cultists. Unsure if they should take it the decision was made for them when it magically disappeared, only to be found later inside Lysander's backpack.
title: Return of the Locket

note:
Title: The Whisper in Chains
Domain: Devils, obedience, corruption of the will.
Symbols: A broken manacle with its ends curled inward like fangs.
title: Information Learned about Sha’tin

note: A ceremonial dagger of blood drinking (Casts cure light wounds on self after sacrificing a creature. Effect destroys victims soul preventing reincarnation or afterlife)
title: Notable Loot

note:
After arriving back in town the mayor informed you that she is writing to the dutchess of Ironford to tell her of your deeds. A week later a letter arrived which disappeared before it could be read. Guessing it was an invitation by Lady Hawthorne was easy enough and the party decided to head out. When the later was later found it read as follows:

To Lysander, Olga, and Stephen,
Your recent deeds in Ashwood have not gone unnoticed. Word of your courage, resourcefulness, and success in protecting the townsfolk from grave danger has reached my attention, and I wish to extend my personal gratitude.
You are cordially invited to my estate for a feast in your honor. It is my hope to meet you in person, hear of your adventures, and discuss opportunities for further service in these lands.
Your presence will be most welcome, and arrangements will be made to ensure your comfort during your stay.
With respect and anticipation,
Lady Selara Hawthorne
Duchess of Ironford
title: A Useful Introduction

note: Some bandits overturned a cart feigning a need for help. They demanded a toll to pass but suddenly changed their turn once their leader fell under a charm effect. It unclear how this happened but was clear that the effect originated with Olga. There was also a few instances of items disappearing
title: Bandits Mysteriously Charmed

note: A group of angry coal burners is met and pacified with offers of alcohol and drugs. They speak about a band of raiders that sack towns carting away it's residents harassing towns. A name of a drug dealer local to Sorinks is shared
title: Rumors of Vrakka's Hand

Wooden blocks with letters are created and left out with the intention of allowing their 'friend' to pick up letters to form words. It is soon learned that Lysander has a telepathic link to his ring which has been 'borrowing' his stuff.
title: Petey

note:
Entering town Petey recognized the guard and told Lysander to bribe him. The guard insulted by this became angry and demanded to search the parties possessions. Petey continued to insist the guard's name was Ruslan even after it became clear his name was Tavik. 
Stumpy, wearing Alric's amulet, allows the female guard to look inside watching her reation carefully. She indicates her attraction to the man pictured inside mistakenly assuming he was Stumpy's lover.
The party is allowed inside
title: A Botched Bribe

note: In town the party meets Kael and Varen. Kael gets into an argument with Stumpy which ends in  a drinking competition that Stumpy wins. Olga befriends Varen and Varen leads Kael upstairs to sleep off the drink
title: The Offended Adventurer

note: Lady Hawthorne throws a feast and invites adventurers and nobles including Kael and Varen. At the event, Lysander tells embellished story of their adventures - crowd loves it, Kael doesn't. A priest of Shelyn mistakenly believes Lyasander worships his goddess. Party notices Lysander now wearing a Shelyn necklace (wasn't there before). Lysander plays along
title: The Party

note: Middle age Wood elf. Lean build, moves with absolute silence. Dark green and brown practical clothing that blends. Wears a small pin with Lady Hawthorne's crest. Lady Hawthorne's intelligence agent. Hired the party for a job
title: Silovan Kreshholm

note: Silovan Kreshholm approaches you at the party and asks you to perform a job for Lady Hawthorne. He wants the party to acquire rare herbs and return them to the mansion. 2500 gold for the job with 300 gold up front. It is made clear that this job is not to be discussed with anyone.
title: Discrete Job

note: Party traveled to Volkmar over two days. Attacked by wolves en route—Lysander badly injured. Arrived and began investigating Borim's location. Petey stole a Poison of Sleeping Death. Decided to find someone who gossips. Met Tavi Redholm (halfling) and Aeris Silvaren (elf) at a tavern. Tavi was telling an exaggerated story about a wolf "two stories high" he barely escaped. Both directed party northeast—Borim likely lives in a cave. Also learned that Borim often harvests rare herbs found in the northeast
title: Journey to Volkmar

note: Party tracked cart tracks near herbs. Led them to Borim's cave. Borim tried to make them leave. Gary (Olga's axe) dominated Borim. Borim gave Lysander a tattoo and created the Crimson Tincture. Two lycanthropes arrived—party killed them. Gave Borim a potion of forgetfulness and made him drink it.
title: Enslaving the Alchemist

note: The party made haste but was run down by a group of large wolves. Turning to fight they realized these were werewolves. Lysander noticed a man watching in the distance and tried to get him to help, but was unsuccessful. The wolves were killed and Olga finished off the Alpha wolf. Killing the Alpha made her axe grow in power.
title: Flight from Wolves

note: Theron, exposed by Lysander, introduces himself. It is learned that he was sent to keep the party safe which he took very literally. He did not help in the fight because he believed they would live. He escorted the party back to town.
title: A chance Encounter

note:
Smoke still rises from several buildings throughout the town - thin gray columns that stain the sky. The town walls show scorch marks and broken sections. The main gate hangs crooked on its hinges.
As you approach, the devastation becomes clearer. The main street is littered with debris - broken furniture, overturned carts, shattered barrels spilling their contents. Windows are smashed. Doors hang open or have been torn from their frames.
A few townspeople move through the wreckage like ghosts, salvaging what they can. They move slowly, mechanically, in shock. Some are bandaged. Others simply stare at nothing.
    • The docks are damaged - pilings broken, debris floating in the water 
    • Several ships are missing from the harbor 
    • Guard posts are abandoned or destroyed 
    • The manor house on the hill shows signs of forced entry 
    • Many buildings are intact but looted 
    • People are alive but traumatized 
Kael and Varen fought the raiders when they hit the tavern. Varen was knocked out and dragged away.
The raiders all had Blue and Orange fish tattoos.
title: Sacking of Sorinsk

note: Theron convinces the sole remaining captain to sail you to Elredd and Highport. Kael agrees to join you. The trip will take approximately 5 days. You set sail on the Silver Surgeon with Captain Casimir Rybar. The next full moon is in four days during which time Hawthorne's brother will likely become a lycanthrope.
title: Bullying a ride

note: The day before arriving in Elredd the ship is attacked by a Kraken. A glancing blow from the creature injures Olga but the wounds regenerate much quicker then they should. After eating about a dozen sailors the Kraken retreats into the depths.
title: Kraken

title: Desna's Whim

note: Mercenary sellsword from the eastern provinces. Met at the slaver's temple where he agreed to help you escape in exchange for his life. He sheltered you in the city while you recovered from your injuries.
title: Drav Kovin

note: Elven noble with some magical training. Drav informed him of you and where you were hiding. He offered to help you in exchange for land and a title under Lady Hawthorne.
title: Caelian di Soliastres
An Unexpected Meeting
note: The next morning, as you recover from your fight at the temple, an elf calling himself Caelian di Soliastres arrives. You are surprised as you were hiding and only Drav knew where you were. He explains that he purchased information about you from Drav, and would like to offer his services in exchange for land and title under Lady Hawthorne. As you offered it to Drav, he expects the offer can be given to him instead.

title: Random Encounters
note:
Encounter check: Roll 1d6 each 2 hours on the trail. Encounter on a 1.
1-2: Orc Patrol (local tribe, toll arrangement with slavers)

4-8 orcs
Behavior: Part of the toll system. If the party looks like slavers or travelers with purpose, the patrol watches from a distance and lets them pass. If the party looks weak, wounded, or lost — which they ARE right now — the orcs get bold. They step onto the trail and demand a toll. 20 gp per head, weapons accepted at inflated value. They don't want a fight but they smell blood. Caelian can talk them down with a good bluff ("we're expected at the stockade, delay us and Markessa hears about it") or the party can pay and move on. Fighting wastes time and mana they don't have.

3: Slaver Merchant Party (heading TO Highport, unaware of the raid)

1 human merchant 
3-6 guards: half-orc fighters 
1 half-orc interpreter
2 mules carrying trade goods 
No slaves — they're heading to buy, not sell
Behavior: Friendly if the party looks like fellow slavers. Suspicious if the party looks like adventurers. The merchant wants to gossip — "How's business at the temple? I heard Sturm got promoted." This is a social encounter. The party can bluff past, rob them for supplies and gold, or pump them for information. The merchant knows the trail, the toll rates, the stockade's reputation, and that "the elf woman doesn't like surprises." He does NOT know the temple was just raided.

4: Escaped Slave (fled during the temple raid chaos)

1 human, barefoot, half-naked, terrified
Running blindly south on the trail because that's the only direction away from the temple
Behavior: Sees the party and freezes. If they look armed, he assumes they're slavers and begs not to be taken back. If they convince him they're friendly, he tells them: the temple is in chaos, guards are searching the city, a caravan of slaves left "a few hours ago" heading south with "maybe ten soldiers and some orcs with whips." He saw them loading the coffle from a hiding spot near the gate. He can confirm direction and rough timing but not exact numbers. He's too weak to travel with the party — they need to point him toward shelter or leave him.

5: Stray War Dogs (escaped from the temple compound during the raid)

2-3 war dogs
Animal 2. No equipment (they're dogs)
Behavior: Trained to attack anyone who doesn't smell like the temple garrison. The party does NOT smell right. The dogs are confused, hungry, and aggressive. They attack on sight, going for the smallest or most wounded party member. Quick fight but it costs hit points the party can't afford to lose right now. Caelian can cast Sleep to drop them instantly — a clean, efficient demonstration of his usefulness.

6: Nothing — but tracks

No encounter, but the party finds fresh tracks on the trail. Shuffling feet in a line (the coffle), boot prints flanking, mule hooves, deeper prints at the rear (armored soldiers). They're close. Theron would read this instantly but Theron isn't here. Caelian can read it if the party asks — "fifteen, maybe twenty people chained together, moving slowly. Half a day ahead at most. We can catch them by nightfall." This confirms the caravan's composition without a fight and builds tension.

title: Ambush
note:
Half-Orc Caravan Boss [Tier 3]
Half-orc. STR 16, DEX 12, CON 15, INT 10, WIS 14, CHA 9
Fighter 4 / Cleric 3. Spells: Bless, Command, Cure Light Wounds,
Darkness, Hold Person, Spiritual Weapon. Long sword, chain mail,
shield. 15 gp.
Behavior: Fights defensively. Threatens to kill slaves as hostages.

HALF-ORC SOLDIERS (4-6)
Fighter 2. Short sword, light crossbow (20 bolts), chain shirt.
1d6+2 gp each. 15% chance of 1 tier_one potion each.
One veteran among them: Tier 1, STR 17, CON 14, Fighter 4,
long sword, chain mail. 2d6+5 gp.
Behavior: Fight in pairs. 3+ dead = consider surrender.

HALF-ORC SCOUTS (2)
Rogue 2. Short sword, short bow (20 arrows), leather armor,
signal horn. 1d4 gp each.
Behavior: 200-400 ft ahead/behind column. Run to warn, don't fight.
ORC HANDLERS (2-3)
Fighter 1. Whip (1d3, reach), short sword (backup), no armor.
1d4 gp each.
Behavior: Drop whips and run if soldiers fall. One might kill a
slave out of spite.

SLAVES (15-20)
Chained in coffle — single chain through manacles, 3 ft apart,
45-60 ft total length.
Notable slaves (pick 3-4):
Sorinsk Farmer (male, 40s): recognizes party from feast. Knows
20 captives left weeks ago, "important ones" separated.
Merchant's Wife (female, 30s): overheard "elf woman's workshop"
and "stockade in mountains." Knows Doran Svetov moved inland.
Foreign Sailor (male, 20s): knows slaver ships are Ghoul and
Reaper. Strong enough to fight if armed.
Child (girl, 10-12): captured near Elredd. No useful intel.
Old Dock Worker (male, 60s): knows temple layout and aspis
alliance from time as labor slave.

NIGHT CAMP (if party catches them at night)
Single fire, banked low. Slaves chained to picket stakes.
2 guards on watch (rotating 4-hr shifts).
Scouts pulled in, camped 50 ft out.
Best window: pre-dawn third watch (groggy guards).
Mules snort if strangers approach upwind.
CARAVAN LOOT
Strongbox on lead mule:
800 gp, 3 gems (100 gp each), 2 gems (200 gp each)
Caravan route map (landmarks to stockade)
Guard roster copy with agent abbreviations
Supplies on mules:
Rations (2 weeks/25 people), water (3 days), rope (100 ft),
spare manacles (6), branding irons (3), whips (2), tarps (2)
